source_title: Polar vs Lemon Squeezy vs Gumroad

snippets.snippet_text: "To avoid holding off my release, I switched to Gumroad so I could start selling right away. Gumroad worked well. It was easy to set up, and I liked the clean interface. But the fees felt a bit high. So once my Lemon Squeezy store was approved, I moved everything back over."
